earnings.title: NXP Semiconductors Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Revenue was $3.79 billion, up 19 percent year-on-year;
GAAP gross margin was 57.8 percent, GAAP operating margin was 32.4 percent and GAAP diluted Net Income per Share was $3.48;
Non-GAAP gross margin was 58.6 percent, non-GAAP operating margin was 37.1 percent, and non-GAAP diluted Net Income per Share was $4.20;
Announces $5 Billion Increase in Share Repurchase Authorization
Cash flow from operations was $1.26 billion, with net capex investments of $50 million, resulting in non-GAAP free cash flow of $1.21 billion or 31.9 percent of revenue;

quotes.text: NXP delivered third-quarter revenue of $3.8 billion, up 19 percent year-on-year and 8 percent sequentially. Our performance was driven by accelerating contributions from our company-specific growth drivers in automotive and industrial as well as continued momentum in data center infrastructure.
quotes.by: Rafael Sotomayor, NXP President and Chief Executive Officer

items.heading: Risks related to the semiconductor industry and the markets in which we participate.
Significantly increased volatility and instability and unfavorable economic conditions may adversely affect our business.
The semiconductor industry is highly competitive. If we fail to introduce new technologies and products in a timely manner, this could adversely affect our business.
The demand for our products depends to a significant degree on the demand for our customers’ end products.
In many of the market segments in which we compete, we depend on winning selection processes, and failure to be selected could adversely affect our business in those market segments.

items.heading: Our global business operations expose us to international business risks that could adversely affect our business.
